meta.source: TESSA_CORE-spec.md §3.8 — authoritative for all colour values
meta.note: SHARED between apps/console and apps/orb. Do not edit without owner approval. CSS and Python are GENERATED from this file — never hand-edit dist/.

bg-ambient.comment: deep navy radial behind the sphere

accent.comment: primary orange — labels, active day, buttons

status-warn.comment: alias of sphere-cool — adds no new hue

status-error.comment: alias of sphere-hot — adds no new hue

state-idle.comment: THE ORB'S IDLE STATE CHIP, and it exists because --status-idle cannot serve here. The Orb's stage is pure black (--theme-void #000000), where --status-idle measures 4.0:1 — 12% short of AA for the chip's 13px type. --status-idle is an ALIAS OF --text-muted and is SHARED with apps/console (CONTRACT §9), so lifting it to fix an Orb-only contrast problem would repaint every muted label in the Console. This is the same grey lifted to 4.53:1: CIEDE2000 3.6 from --text-muted, close enough that the surface still reads as one grey family. No new hue (§9.1) — it is the same H240 S0.03 neutral at a different lightness.

prov-human.comment: provenance gutter — owner typed it. CONTRACT §6.2

theme-void.comment: ORB THEMES — pure black stage. NOT a replacement for bg-void, which stays #08080A for apps/console. The Orb overrides bg-void with this at runtime; see apps/orb/src/renderer/theme.ts.

theme-magenta-core.comment: THE REFERENCE'S ACTIVE SPHERE. No longer the default — gold is, by the owner's word; magenta remains a palette and remains the only theme any measurement supports. Hue 308 is MEASURED, not chosen: the dominant bright hue agrees at 307.5-312.5 across all sixteen v2 reference photographs, spread 10 degrees. None of the sixteen is a direct capture, so the method is agreement across independent shots. hsl(308,100%,72%), contrast 8.78:1.

theme-magenta-idle.comment: hsl(308,100%,42%), 4.57:1 - above AA on the black stage

companion-left-hot.comment: THE BACKGROUND COMPANIONS DO NOT THEME. These are identities, not palette: switching the active theme must not repaint them or three companions become one companion three times. Measured hue 307 (magenta), 7.08:1.

companion-left-cool.comment: the left companion's cool end. Dim by design - it sits behind a panel.

companion-right-hot.comment: measured hue 152.7 (green) off image1 at the sphere itself. 13.23:1.

theme-gold-core.comment: GOLD IS THE DEFAULT. NOT measured from the reference and deliberately not: all sixteen reference images are magenta AND all sixteen are photographs, so the reference cannot supply this hue. Gold is a colour the owner named by word, so web gold #FFD700 is taken as GIVEN and what is measured is the RESULT. Hue held at web gold's own 50.6 through all three steps. hsl(51,100%,72%), contrast 17.10:1 on the black stage.

theme-gold-body.comment: WEB GOLD EXACTLY, unaltered - this is --accent under gold and it is the value he named. 14.97:1. CIEDE2000 37.6 from --accent orange #FF6B1A and 20.3 from --status-warn: it cannot be mistaken for the orange he ruled out. dE 11.4 from metallic #D4AF37, which he also ruled out.

theme-gold-idle.comment: hsl(51,100%,33%), 6.54:1 - well above AA on black. 33% rather than 38% specifically to hold dE 10.9 from metallic gold #D4AF37; at 38% the dim step lands at dE 4.8 from it, which is inside the range where two colours read as the same colour.

theme-red-core.comment: RED, at hue 348 (crimson) and NOT at the alarm's hue. --status-error is #FF3B00 at hue 14, and a theme whose accent reads as the alarm is a surface with no alarm - the same fault the retired ember palette carried at dE 6.9. Hue 348 is the swept value that maximises that distance while staying unambiguously red: dE 24.3 here. 7.96:1.

theme-red-body.comment: hsl(348,85%,55%), 5.09:1. dE 18.1 from --status-error and 26.7 from --theme-magenta-body, so it is neither the alarm nor the magenta theme. This is --accent under red.

theme-red-idle.comment: hsl(348,90%,48%), 4.56:1 - and it is BRIGHTER than the other five idle steps on purpose. A saturated red carries little luminance, so the dim step cannot go dark and stay above AA on black: at 40% lightness it measures 3.37:1 and fails. This is the honest cost of a red palette, reported rather than hidden.

theme-cyan-core.comment: SPHERE LADDER, scoped change. Was #E8FBFF at 95% lightness, where no hue survives - the sphere rendered grey. Measured against the reference build, whose shell stays saturated. hsl(188,100%,80%), contrast 15.13:1.

theme-cyan-idle.comment: derived at H188 to 56% of body's contrast: 7.81:1

theme-violet-core.comment: owner-supplied. 7.72:1 — the DIMMEST core of the five; blue carries only 0.0722 of luminance, so this hue cannot reach cyan's 19.67 and stay violet

theme-violet-idle.comment: derived at H255, floored at 4.0:1 so it stays visible on black

mono.comment: bundled as woff2 — not installed on the owner's machine

full-layout-min-width.comment: CONTRACT §9.2 — rail+left+right+transcript = 888px of chrome. On the owner's 1366x768 display that leaves ~478px of centre stage. Below this breakpoint, panels MUST collapse to overlays/drawers.

rules.comment: CONTRACT §9.1 — standing style rules binding both surfaces.
